# TPC-Havoc Q12_v7

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
select
    l_shipmode,
    count(*) filter (where o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' or o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH') as high_line_count,
    count(*) filter (where o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT' and o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH') as low_line_count
from
    orders,
    lineitem
where
    o_orderkey = l_orderkey
    and l_shipmode in ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
    and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate
    and l_shipdate < l_commitdate
    and l_receiptdate >= date '1994-01-01'
    and l_receiptdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year
group by
    l_shipmode
order by
    l_shipmode
```
